item.title: Staff Ed: Despite AI, Journalism Industry's Future Shines Bright - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Throughout the course of history, the journalism industry has made many adjustments and that continues to happen today with AI. The Graphic shares why journalism is not dead and instead has a bright future.

item.title: Opinion: Propaganda Dictates Reality - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: In today's media-saturated world, the information we consume does more than inform us — it shapes the way we see the world. Perspectives Staff Writer Eva Shauriki argues propaganda dictates our reality and dilutes our ability to form our own opinions and beliefs.

item.title: Pepperdine Graphic Print 3.20.2026 - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: The post Pepperdine Graphic Print 3.20.2026 appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Stuns UC Davis with Buzzer-Beater in Postseason Thriller - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Junior guard Taija Sta. Maria’s buzzer-beating step-back three lifted Pepperdine past UC Davis 71–68 in a historic postseason win at Firestone Fieldhouse on March 19. The Waves advance to the second round of the WNIT, facing Southern Utah at Firestone Fieldhouse on March 22 at 2 p.m.

item.title: Before the Auditions: How the Theatre Program Selects Its Shows - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: While the Theatre Department produces its four annual shows, it's simultaneously gearing up for the next season's slate of productions. The process involves figures from all levels of the University, including administrators.

item.title: Baseball Midseason Outlook: Waves' Pitching Dominates and Coaching Expertise Grows - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Pepperdine Baseball is on a roll as they defeated the University of San Diego Toreros in their conference home opener and took one game on the road from the Gonzaga University Bulldogs April 2-4. The Waves' pitching has posted a 4.04 team ERA during conference play leading the team to five wins.

item.title: Beyond the Stats: Daniel Patterson Steps Up to the Plate as a Game-Changing Leader - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Pepperdine Baseball’s Daniel Patterson has made an impact that goes far beyond what his statistics show. His commitment to his team has defined both his own success and his presence within the program.

item.title: SGA Elects 2026-27 President and Executive VP - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: The student body elected sophomores Emily Espinosa and Jandy Nguyen on March 25 to serve as the Student Government Association's next president and executive vice president, respectively. The Graphic spoke with the two about their upcoming positions.

item.title: Crossover: Pepperdine Men’s Basketball Brings Faith to the Court - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Pepperdine Men’s Basketball is redefining competition by pairing Division I athletics with spiritual growth. Raul Ortiz, character coach and chaplain for the team, helps shape who the Waves become beyond the court.

item.title: 'It's Heartbreaking': Wait Continues for Fraser Michael Bohm Trial - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: A trial date was not set for Fraser Michael Bohm at the April 9 pre-trial hearing at the Van Nuys Courthouse.

item.title: The Newest Wave: Women's Basketball Head Coach Balances Motherhood with Leadership - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: In February, Katie Faulkner, Women's Basketball head coach, gave birth to her third child, Cali Jo. Just 10 days later, Faulkner was back coaching the Waves with Cali close by.

item.title: Men's Basketball Begins Griff Aldrich Era - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: After announcing the University was parting ways with Head Coach Ed Schilling on March 9, Pepperdine Men's Basketball began searching for their new leader. Less than a month later, Director of Athletics Tanner Gardner announced Griff Aldrich as the program's 14th official head coach.

item.title: Pepperdine Political Groups Reflect on Free Speech - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: In the midst of political polarization, political groups on campus are navigating free speech. Presidents of Pepperdine College Republicans, Pepperdine College Democrats and Pepperdine TPUSA all spoke to the Graphic about the First Amendment right.

item.title: Farewell Firestone Fieldhouse - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Pepperdine's Mountain at Mullin Park is set to open in fall 2026. For the past 53 years, Firestone Fieldhouse served as Pepperdine's host arena, and The Mountain's opening will mark the end of an era.
